{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print(f"Unique values in revenue (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")"}
